methodology.transport: sequential loopback HTTP, 1 KiB JSON response; timers include body consumption
methodology.startup: one module-warm StudioServer.start; excludes module/process/browser startup
methodology.rss: sampled process RSS across target, two proxies, studio and benchmark client; not isolated or guaranteed peak

limitations: No Postman measurement or speed comparison.
Not a cold-start, browser responsiveness, concurrency/load, large-payload or long-duration leak test.
Single-machine observation; rerun before setting release performance gates.
